No.
F. 2(1)/2020-Pub, dated 4.5.2020.---The
following Ordinance promulgated on 30th April, 2020 by the President is hereby
published for general information:-
WHEREAS
it is expedient to amend the Companies Act, 2017 (XIX of 2017), for the
purposes hereinafter appearing;

WHEREAS the Senate and the National Assembly are not in session and the
President is satisfied that circumstances exist which render it necessary to
take immediate action;

Constitution of Islamic Republic of Pakistan, the President of the Islamic
Republic of Pakistan is pleased to make and promulgate the following
Ordinance:- 1. Short title and
commencement.---(1) This Ordinance shall be called the Companies
(Amendment) Ordinance, 2020.
(2) It
shall come into force at once.
